subject.title: [Feature Request] Group pairing flow: notify owner + read-only mode for unconfigured groups

question: Should unapproved groups remain completely unprocessed until owner approval, or may their messages enter a restricted reader context while approval is pending?
rationale: The options create materially different authorization, prompt-injection, session-state, and privacy boundaries, and current source intentionally keeps DM pairing state separate from group authorization.

options.title: Notification-Only Pairing
options.body: Create pending group state and notify the owner, but drop all group messages until explicit approval.

options.title: Sandboxed Observation
options.body: Allow pending messages only in a separately isolated reader with no replies, privileged tools, or trusted-session memory.

options.title: Keep Explicit Configuration
options.body: Retain configuration-only group authorization and address unknown groups through separate notification or warn/leave features.

recommendation.title: Notification-Only Pairing
recommendation.body: Create pending group state and notify the owner, but drop all group messages until explicit approval.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared authorization boundary and deliberate separation between DM pairing and group access are concentrated in Peter Steinberger's merged history.
